openwrt_wiki.einleitung: The Xiaomi Redmi Router AC2100 is a wireless router based on the MT7621 platform. While it can be acquired for relatively low cost compared to other units with similar specifications, it requires a somewhat complex installation process in order to bypass a locked down stock firmware to install OpenWrt.
openwrt_wiki.installation: Methode A (Web Exploit) und Methode B (Python Exploit); Details bewusst nicht übernommen
openwrt_wiki.opening_the_case: There are two Phillips head screws hidden behind the label on the bottom. Once these are removed, the case can be pried open all along one side (the one without connectors) with a flat head screwdriver.
openwrt_wiki.serial_diagramm: J1: VCC RX GND TX (VCC quadratisches Pad)
openwrt_wiki.stock_recovery: This device accepts stock signed firmware images from Xiaomi, when booted to PXE. PXE can be triggered by holding down the reset button on the device while powering on, until the status light flashes amber. File should be renamed to "miwifi.bin". DHCP server and TFTP server should be configured on the PC (dhcp-range 192.168.31.50-150). After the device flashes the image from TFTP, it will flash the status light white. Alternatively MiWifiRepairToolx86 for Windows.
openwrt_wiki.breed: BREED-Bootloader als Alternative beschrieben (Zugriff 192.168.1.1, Reset beim Einschalten)
openwrt_wiki.uart_recovery: Mit gesetzten Boot-Variablen uart_en=1, boot_wait=on, bootdelay=5 lässt sich U-Boot unterbrechen und initramfs per TFTP laden (Menüpunkt 1)
